niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, well-structured interfaces that feel complete and easy to scan. They like strong visual hierarchy, clear labels, distinct section grouping, and enough content density to avoid empty or unfinished-looking screens. They generally prefer light backgrounds, high contrast, compact but not crowded layouts, and simple task-focused flows with clear primary actions. They also tend to favor restrained, premium-looking alerts and modals over loud, highly alarming, or overly decorative presentations.

criteria.description: Multiple clearly separated sections or cards with tidy grouping and consistent row structure, rather than fragmented, inconsistent, or sparse sections.
A title-first layout with clear emphasis on headings, primary actions, and key content, so the screen is immediately scannable.
Screens that feel fully populated and purposeful, with visible labels, rows, controls, and little to no empty or unfinished-looking space.
Light backgrounds, crisp contrast, and clean polished surfaces that feel bright, modern, and easy to read.
A layout that is compact and efficient while still leaving enough breathing room to avoid clutter or vertical bulk.
Straightforward, task-oriented flows with clear progress cues, direct copy, and minimal distracting chrome or decorative elements.
